summary.en: A release history as a journey: the camera sprints along a time axis past milestone cards that spring up as it reaches them, brakes hard on the last one and pushes in.
summary.zh: 把版本史拍成一次时间轴旅行：镜头沿刻度轴缓起、冲刺，每到一个刻度那张卡片从轴上弹立，末刻度急刹并推近。

fits: A history whose speed is the point (shipping often, years of work) ending on the milestone the film is about.
notFor: Histories the viewer must read item by item (only the last two cards are readable); more than five milestones.

overlaps.note: a one-screen truck between assets; milestone-run travels several screens with a sprint and a brake (its curve is proposed as camera-truck's travel variant)
a vertical list braking on its key item; milestone-run is horizontal travel through history

intent.en: Tell a history as speed: past versions flash by like scenery, and the hard stop on today says 'this is what matters now'.
intent.zh: 把一段历史讲成速度：过去的版本像窗外风景一样闪过，在“今天”急刹，说明“现在这个最重要”。

content.en: 3–5 milestones, each a label (en ≤ 6 chars, zh ≤ 3), a date (en ≤ 8, zh ≤ 5), a title (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 8), a two-line description (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 20) and a metric (en ≤ 20, zh ≤ 8); an eyebrow and a headline (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 14).
content.zh: 3–5 个里程碑，每个一个标签（英文 ≤ 6 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字）、日期（英文 ≤ 8，中文 ≤ 5）、标题（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 8）、两行描述（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 20）和一个指标（英文 ≤ 20，中文 ≤ 8）；一行眉标和一句大标题（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 14）。

fits.zh: 速度本身就是重点的一段历史（发版很勤、多年积累），落在本片要讲的那个里程碑上。

notFor.zh: 要逐条读的历史（只有最后两张卡读得清）；超过五个里程碑。

pairs.note: after the stop on today, make that version the protagonist

en: Leave at least a second still after the brake; plan the end first and work the travel backwards.
Only the last two cards are read; put the milestone that matters last and keep the earlier ones glanceable.
zh: 急刹后至少留 1 秒静止；排时间线时先留好末段，再倒推行程。
只有最后两张卡读得清；把要讲的里程碑放最后，前面的只求一瞥。

upstream.name: 时间线穿行
upstream.summary: 时间轴横移——镜头沿水平刻度轴加速掠过版本刻度，每过一格卡片弹立短停，末刻度急停推近
upstream.use: changelog/里程碑/发展史段落（"我们一直在发货"的另一种拍法）；与 scroll-brake-moves 分工：那卡是纵向列表急刹，本卡是横向时间旅行
upstream.energy: 中高（加速→急刹的节奏型镜头）
